verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents workspace-level hard budgets (daily/weekly/monthly/lifetime dollar caps that auto-block requests) and programmatic API key management, and community users confirm per-key limits/expiry and billing caps in practice. However, there's no explicit evidence of a distinct 'per-user' budget control separate from workspace/team budgets, and no docs on granular alerting or per-team-member spend allocation beyond workspace-wide caps. Missing for 10: explicit per-user spend limit configuration, and independent verification of team-level (multi-member) budget enforcement beyond workspace scope.
